scope: experiments/*/run/metrics.json, environment/checks/**/metrics.json, and experiments/experiment_log.csv only; excludes source_snapshot, copied checkpoints, inference-only bundles, and other directories
unit: processed next-token targets in optimizer updates
counting_rule: For completed runs, count the full training_run_tokens when present; otherwise use metrics.train_tokens only when it represents the completed run, not a selected checkpoint. One optimizer run is counted once by its unique run metrics path and checkpoint SHA-256. A continuation contributes only its new optimizer updates. An ensemble contributes no additional optimizer updates.
